title: Reading Drill — Comparing labels on an herb trail — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing labels on an herb trail — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The garden educator in Elmbrook received an old report about visitors mixing up plants with similar leaves. The report compared correct identifications, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the visitor worksheets rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include plants not in bloom. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed side-by-side drawings as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
